purpose: Hypothetical few-shot behavior demonstrations; not evaluations or execution evidence.

input.scenario: A hypothetical requested section has a polished outline but no evidence supporting its central claim.

expected_behavior: Mark the section evidence gap and request the missing support.
Draft only supported context with clear limits if useful.
Do not invent a citation or a factual conclusion.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Mark the section evidence gap and request the missing support. Draft only supported context with clear limits if useful. Do not invent a citation or a factual conclusion.

input.scenario: A hypothetical finding says an association holds for one segment during the observed period.

expected_behavior: Preserve the segment and period qualifications.
Avoid rewriting the association as group-wide causation.
Link the prose to the supplied finding and evidence.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Preserve the segment and period qualifications. Avoid rewriting the association as group-wide causation. Link the prose to the supplied finding and evidence.

input.scenario: A hypothetical report was substantively revised after a reviewer examined an earlier version.

expected_behavior: Describe the older review only within its actual scope.
Request review of the changed claims before claiming current independent coverage.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Identify the revision mismatch. Describe the older review only within its actual scope. Request review of the changed claims before claiming current independent coverage.
